title: Bihar SI aspirants march in Patna against cancelled mains exam
seoTitle: Patna SI aspirants' protest over exam cancellation

tea.why: The BPSSC cancelled the sub-inspector mains exam for 1,799 posts on Sept 23, days before the physical test, citing 'unavoidable reasons'.
tea.want: Revoke the cancellation of the mains exam and announce dates for the physical efficiency test.
tea.changed: Oct 5: aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan towards the CM's residence and were stopped by police at JP Golambar.

summary: Candidates who passed the Bihar Police sub-inspector preliminary exam in January and the mains exam on May 28 have been protesting in Patna since the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission cancelled the mains exam on September 23, citing 'unavoidable reasons'. The cancellation affects recruitment to 1,799 posts and came days before the scheduled physical efficiency test, for which candidates say they had trained for four months. After about 10 days of a sit-in at the Gardanibagh protest site, aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan towards the chief minister's residence on October 5 and were stopped by police at JP Golambar. They say no concrete reason for the cancellation has been given.
demands: Withdraw the cancellation of the SI mains exam
response: The BPSSC cited 'unavoidable reasons' for the cancellation; police stopped the Oct 5 march at JP Golambar. No further official response is reported.

updates.text: The BPSSC cancelled the SI mains exam for 1,799 posts, citing unavoidable reasons.
Aspirants began a sit-in at the Gardanibagh protest site.
A march towards the CM's residence was stopped by police at JP Golambar.
